limitations: Application depends on derivation under applicable law, the distributor's role, the Work's components and any condition-specific exemptions. Compliance with 6(d) alone does not establish compliance with all of clause 6.
reasoning: For a non-Current Maintainer distributing a Derived Work within clause 6(d), at least one item must accompany the Derived Work: a complete, unmodified copy of the Work or information sufficient to obtain one. Under 6(d)(1), offering equivalent access from the same or a similar place satisfies the copy option when a modified component is offered for copying at a designated place. Recipients need not download both.
